parameters.content:
# TOR tags v4

Self-contained: all prompts, schemas and Code logic are embedded.

Connect **Prepare AI Prompt → Capture AI Inputs**. Each item needs a string projectId and full sourceText (preferred) or aiPrompt. Batch size at most 25. Select the MongoDB account credential on the four MongoDB nodes. Database: bangkok_tor_db.

Canonical tags: **text, category, type**. Type is required: **contractor_requirement** or **specification**. RequirementLevel belongs ONLY on each TOR-to-tag assignment, never on the canonical tag.

Missing tags are created; existing assignments and manual decisions are preserved. AI assignments are suggested until reviewed. No database validators are added. Model defaults to qwen3.5:9bu; optional per-item aiModel and ollamaUrl override the defaults. Verify the model exists and the Ollama URL is reachable from n8n.

Structured aiExtractedRequirements remain categorized objects. aiProcessing.version is now 4. Inspect the final verification node for status, warnings and missing projects. More canonical tag types can be introduced later by extending the vocabulary.

Tag upserts use category + text, backed by uq_tags_category_text. Legacy tag fields are optional in MongoDB. A winning bid/award value is never a project budget.
